- Added `facade.runtime_accessor_shape` registry field: "ref" (default) | "closure". [...] - Closure mode emits `self.<accessor>(|app| <concept_fn>(app, ...))`, mapping accessor `None` (dead/inert handle) → OpenFailed on open / false on close (idempotent D6), and keeping the concept door's own error on the same variant ref mode uses per target shape (JSON→OpenFailed, plain-string→InvalidTarget).
- Ref-mode output is byte-identical (early dispatch), so no existing iOS facade drifts. Swift/Kotlin wrappers untouched — signatures identical, only Rust host access changes. [...] - Generator stays concept-crate-dependency-free: host-type-agnostic, stamps `app` as the door's first arg (symmetric to ref mode's `self.<accessor>()`).
